why_angle: The cited rivals give tilt and lumens but never compare beam width across models. Lumary's own release gives a 26° beam for the 90°-tilt Plus, 45° for the 40°-tilt Standard 9 W and 100° for the 6-inch 355°/20° model. Their solid angles (0.161, 0.478 and 2.244 sr) show that tilt alone doesn't decide which gimbal can spotlight art or a wall. Our live page's advice that the RGBAI Pro (Pro Max) suits 'aiming at art and walls' has no beam figure behind it.
